mission_presets.name: Jezero West Delta
mission_presets.summary: Primary geological traverse from lander egress to delta front. Outcrop cores and regolith collection.

mission_presets.name: Belva Impact Rim
mission_presets.summary: High-elevation impact rim survey with strict 16° slope hold margins and boulder avoidance.

mission_presets.name: Neretva Vallis Channel
mission_presets.summary: Fluvial inlet channel transect to map ancient braided river gravels and fine mudstone deposits.

mission_presets.name: Séítah Dune Crossing
mission_presets.summary: Navigating layered olivine-rich cumulate rocks across active ripple and sand dune corridors.

mission_presets.name: Three Forks Cache
mission_presets.summary: Sample return depot route. Inspect tube drop orientation and verify witness cylinder seal integrity.

mission_presets.name: Margin Carbonates
mission_presets.summary: Paleolake shoreline carbonate bench analysis to detect potential micro-fossil stromatolite structures.

mission_presets.name: Kodiak Mesa Reconnaissance
mission_presets.summary: Steep stratigraphy survey of the isolated remnant delta butte to document bottomset-to-foreset transitions.

mission_presets.name: Hawksbill Gap Exploration
mission_presets.summary: Fine-grained sedimentary rock sampling in high-priority astrobiology target zones.

checklists.title: Pre-EVA checklist
checklists.description: Pre-EVA preparation from T−24 h to hatch open.

items.title: Objectives and timeline
items.detail: Tasks, stops and durations set; timeline padded (Apollo 15/16 tasks ran ~70% longer than in training)

items.title: Route geometry
items.detail: Distance, elevation gain/loss and max slope inside the suit slope limit; uphill and downhill costed separately

items.title: Walkback limit
items.detail: Every point on the route within walkback distance of the habitat (10 km, Apollo-derived) if the rover fails

items.title: Terrain hazards and map quality
items.detail: Crater rims, scarps, sand traps flagged; segments below HiRISE resolution (~25–30 cm/px) marked low-confidence

items.title: Rocks and footing
items.detail: Rock abundance and thermal-inertia soft-ground proxy reviewed along the route

items.title: No-go zones
items.detail: Route clear of planetary-protection special regions

items.title: Lighting plan
items.detail: Sun elevation, sunset and shadow maps for the EVA window; no stop in deep shadow

items.title: Planned load
items.detail: Tool and sample mass entered so the load term is in the energy budget

items.title: Dust opacity forecast
items.detail: Optical depth below the mission limit; watch Ls ~140–180° storm season

items.title: Thermal window
items.detail: Start time placed against the diurnal cycle (ground 150–300 K); no cold-soak at the far stop

items.title: Space weather
items.detail: No SPE warning; shelter reachable from every stop within the mission rule

items.title: Planned dose
items.detail: GCR 0.56–0.65 mSv/day × hours outside fits the crew member's remaining dose budget (IB14)

items.title: Aerobic capacity
items.detail: Latest VO2peak at or above the NASA partial-g EVA standard of 36.5 mL/kg/min

items.title: Sensorimotor state
items.detail: Days since landing logged; balance and gait test passed (deficit largest in first hours, marked gains within 24 h)

items.title: Muscle and bone
items.detail: Post-transit strength and bone density on file; load and slope limits lowered if needed

items.title: Orthostatic tolerance
items.detail: Stand test without dizziness

items.title: Sleep and circadian phase
items.detail: No sleep debt; schedule aligned to the 24.65 h sol

items.title: Hydration and nutrition
items.detail: Urine specific gravity and body mass normal; pre-EVA meal taken

items.title: Injury and acute health
items.detail: No new pain (shoulder, hand, back), illness or sedating medication

items.title: Hypoxia check
items.detail: SpO2 normal in the 8.2 psia / 34% O2 cabin

items.title: Psychological state
items.detail: Crew member and buddy report ready; no unresolved crew conflict

items.title: Familiarity
items.detail: Route and tasks rehearsed; first EVA on this terrain flagged for slower pacing

items.title: Carry-over from last EVA
items.detail: Last post-EVA suit inspection closed out; no open seal or glove defects

items.title: Fit
items.detail: Suit sized for this crew member; pressure points and glove fit checked

items.title: Suit + PLSS mass and CG
items.detail: Actual mass entered (Mars weight = 0.38 × mass; inertia stays full)

items.title: Consumables loadout
items.detail: O2, CO2 removal, water and battery full; planned EVA plus walkback fits the design limit (up to 8 h)

items.title: CO2 sensor
items.detail: Reading live and below the 3.8 mmHg design average

items.title: Cooling garment
items.detail: Loop flowing; heat-storage limit 1.9–3.0 kJ/kg set in the alert model

items.title: Displays
items.detail: HUD or tablet readable with pressurised gloves

items.title: Leak check
items.detail: Suit holds operating pressure before depress

items.title: Cabin atmosphere
items.detail: Habitat at 8.2 psia / 34% O2 (prebreathe ~0–30 min, vs 6.5–7 h from 14.7 psia)

items.title: DCS risk
items.detail: Model risk accepted (8.4% for 15-min prebreathe + 6 h at 4.3 psi; up to 10.9% for 8 h); prebreathe timer complete

items.title: Line of sight
items.detail: Viewshed shows where voice/data to the habitat drops; relay placed or blind segments accepted

items.title: Earth link
items.detail: One-way delay (~3–22 min) noted; habitat crew holds real-time support; no solar conjunction blackout

items.title: Buddy and IV staffing
items.detail: Buddy assigned with a maximum separation; IV crew on console for the full EVA

items.title: Rover
items.detail: Rover position and status known if used to shorten return time

items.title: Marswalk verdict
items.detail: Verdict shows GO, or CAUTION accepted by EV crew and IV lead

items.title: Turn-back time
items.detail: Clock time set at which return starts, whatever the task state

items.title: Abort triggers
items.detail: Abort triggers briefed (see Hold criteria)

items.title: Pre-EVA baselines
items.detail: Heart rate, PVT reaction time, body mass, fatigue and soreness scores recorded

checklists.title: During-EVA checklist
checklists.description: Active tasks and checkpoints during EVA execution.

items.title: Egress + HUD link check
items.detail: Airlock depress, outer hatch egress, establish telemetry handshake and verify HUD reticle alignment

items.title: WP1 · Panorama
items.detail: Reach Waypoint 1, shoot 360-degree gigapixel survey panorama and record geological context

items.title: WP3 · Core sample
items.detail: Acquire drill core sample from delta outcrop, verify seal integrity and place in hermetic sample tube

items.title: Consumables check
items.detail: Cross-check O2 pressure drop against metabolic prediction model; verify coolant loop temperature

items.title: WP5 · Regolith scoop
items.detail: Perform shallow soil trench and scoop regolith aliquot into volatile capture container

items.title: Ingress
items.detail: Return traverse complete, enter airlock, seal outer hatch and initiate repressurization

checklists.title: Post-EVA checklist
checklists.description: Post-EVA inspection, data collation, medical checks, and readiness for next EVA.

items.title: Dust off before doffing
items.detail: Suit brushed or vacuumed in the airlock; particle counter running (peaks come at suit ingress)

items.title: Habitat dust level
items.detail: Respirable dust (<10 µm) on track for the 24 h average limit of 0.1 mg/m³

items.title: Samples bagged
items.detail: Sealed and labelled for perchlorate and toxic-element handling (Cr, Co, Ni) before entering the cabin

items.title: Exposure check
items.detail: No eye, skin or airway irritation after doffing

items.title: Repress and DCS watch
items.detail: Repress from ~4.3 psi to 8.2 psia logged; DCS symptom check at repress and at end of watch window (mission rule)

items.title: Injury report
items.detail: Falls, abrasions, hand and shoulder pain logged with severity: first aid, medical attention, lost duty time

items.title: Hydration
items.detail: Post-EVA body mass and urine output vs pre-EVA baseline; rehydrate against the 240 mL/h EVA fluid need

items.title: Heat strain
items.detail: Core temperature and heart rate returning to baseline; peak heat storage reviewed against 3.0 kJ/kg

items.title: Suit and glove damage
items.detail: Visual inspection of seals, bearings, visor and gloves; leak check

items.title: Cleaning and maintenance
items.detail: Turnaround task list opened; estimated time to suit-ready logged

items.title: Consumables recharge
items.detail: O2, water, battery and CO2 sorbent recharged; actual use per hour recorded to calibrate the metabolic model

items.title: Dose ledger
items.detail: EVA dose added to each crew member's mission total (surface ~0.6 mSv/day vs cruise ~1.8 mSv/day)

items.title: As-walked map
items.detail: Actual track, new hazards and footing notes uploaded; DTM blind spots corrected for the next route

items.title: Planned vs actual
items.detail: Time, distance, metabolic rate and consumables compared with the plan; variance fed back to the planner

items.title: Earth package
items.detail: Telemetry and notes sent; review expected after 2 × one-way delay plus analysis time

items.title: Physical and mental fatigue
items.detail: 0–10 scores vs pre-EVA

items.title: PVT and working memory
items.detail: Short battery vs pre-EVA baseline

items.title: Recovery time to baseline
items.detail: Hours until resting heart rate, respiration and temperature return to pre-EVA levels (wearable)

items.title: DOMS
items.detail: Soreness score at 24 h and 48 h, especially after long downhill segments

items.title: Sleep
items.detail: Duration and efficiency on the night after the EVA (actigraphy)

items.title: Debrief
items.detail: Stress, perceived success, what slowed the crew; route or HUD changes captured

items.title: Cumulative fatigue
items.detail: Fatigue, soreness and sleep back near baseline

items.title: Cadence
items.detail: Time to next EVA fits recovery and the crew-week budget (NASA plans up to 24 h EVA per crew-week)

items.title: Suit ready
items.detail: EA2, EA3 and EA10 closed

items.title: Dose budget
items.detail: Remaining budget covers the next planned EVA

items.title: Next Pre-EVA baselines
items.detail: Injuries, fatigue and dose carried into the next crew-readiness block

hold_criteria.title: Body heat storage
hold_criteria.limit: Alert at 1.9 kJ/kg, abort at 3.0 kJ/kg

hold_criteria.title: Suit CO2
hold_criteria.limit: 3.8 mmHg design average; headaches reported at 2.8–4.5 mmHg
hold_criteria.source: Sourced; abort level is a mission rule

hold_criteria.title: Consumables
hold_criteria.limit: Remaining time = min(O2, water, power ÷ use rate) must exceed return time
hold_criteria.source: Formula sourced; margin is a mission rule

hold_criteria.title: SPE shelter reach
hold_criteria.limit: Time from any stop to shelter

hold_criteria.title: DCS watch window
hold_criteria.limit: Hours of symptom watch after repress
